1.t: Was there not a period of time when man was nothing to speak of ?

2.t: We created man from a drop of mingled fluid to put him to the test; We gave him hearing and sight;

3.t: We guided him to the right path, whether he was grateful or not.

4.t: We have prepared chains, iron collars, and blazing Fire for the disbelievers, but

5.t: the righteous will have a drink mixed with kafur,

6.t: a spring for God’s servants, which flows abundantly at their wish.

7.t: They fulfil their vows; they fear a day of widespread woes;

8.t: they give food to the poor, the orphan, and the captive, though they love it themselves,

9.t: saying, ‘We feed you for the sake of God alone: We seek neither recompense nor thanks from you.

10.t: We fear the Day of our Lord––a woefully grim Day.’

11.t: So God will save them from the woes of that Day, give them radiance and gladness,

12.t: and reward them, for their steadfastness, with a Garden and silken robes.

13.t: They will sit on couches, feeling neither scorching heat nor biting cold,

14.t: with shady [branches] spread above them and clusters of fruit hanging close at hand.

15.t: They will be served with silver plates

16.t: and gleaming silver goblets according to their fancy,

17.t: and they will be given a drink infused with ginger

19.t: Everlasting youths will attend them––if you could see them, you would think they were scattered pearls––

20.t: and if you were to look around, you would see bliss and great wealth:

21.t: they will wear garments of green silk and brocade; they will be adorned with silver bracelets; their Lord will give them a pure drink.

22.t: [It will be said], ‘This is your reward. Your endeavours are appreciated.’

23.t: We Ourself have sent down this Quran to you [Prophet] in gradual revelation.

24.t: Await your Lord’s Judgement with patience; do not yield to any of these sinners or disbelievers;

25.t: remember the name of your Lord at dawn and in the evening;

26.t: bow down before Him, and glorify Him at length by night.

27.t: These people love the fleeting life. They put aside [all thoughts of] a Heavy Day.

28.t: Yet We created them; We strengthened their constitution; if We please, We can replace such people completely.

29.t: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes, take the way to his Lord.

30.t: But you will only wish to do so if God wills- God is all knowing, all wise-

31.t: He admits whoever He will into His Mercy and has prepared a painful torment for the disbelievers.
